title: Flexibility Over Storage
goal: Change the function signature so it accepts fixed arrays as well as vectors.
hints: `&Vec<i32>` requires a heap vector. It rejects fixed arrays.
A slice reference `&[i32]` accepts both arrays and vectors.
explanation: The type `&[i32]` borrows any integer sequence without caring if it lives in an array or a Vec. Demanding `&Vec<i32>` causes `E0308` when passing an array reference like `&data`. Using plain `[i32]` without a reference triggers `E0277` because slice sizes are not known at compile time. Passing `total(data)` by value fails because the function expects a reference.
